calls.title: Sr Product Designer Portfolio Review - Towsiful
calls.summary: The team introduced a new design control feature designed to enhance traceability and improve user experience within Ultralight Labs’ medical device compliance platform. This feature directly addresses bottlenecks in workflows by connecting user needs and design inputs with documentation that adheres to FDA compliance. A project management-style Kanban board has been implemented to visualize these interdependencies, improving task management and integration with tools like Jira and GitHub. The feature was rolled out incrementally to ensure thorough testing and alignment with regulatory requirements. Continuous engagement with engineering and user feedback facilitated necessary refinements, ultimately leading to increased active users and the successful acquisition of Ultralight Labs by Greenlight Guru, underscoring the feature's market validation.
calls.keywords: Design Control, Medical Device Compliance, User Experience, Cross-functional Collaboration, Prototyping, Product Roadmap
